query:
The Clay & Fire Collective operates on an apparent norm that work in progress is not photographed or shared without the maker's permission. Does this norm apply equally to all members?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Reuben
C. Simone
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Callum, said_by=Simone, profile, t8 @2026-05-17T09:38:00) Simone wants to photograph Callum's plate set for a proper record before they go to Portugal.
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:42:00) okay so here's the thing, I've been thinking about doing a group critique session properly in March -- not just a quick chat but a proper round of feedback. I'm wondering if we should do it as the main activity rather than alongside throwing. thoughts? I can set it up properly -- printed notes, the whole thing. 📋
[3] (about=Reuben, core, t12 @2026-07-19T09:49:00) Acknowledges it means another week's work but doing it wrong because it's faster produces mediocre work; process must be right before surface can be right.
[4] (about=Simone, core, t6 @2026-04-12T09:43:00) Has gotten good at ceramics photography; offers to take photos for group.
[5] (about=Simone, core, t8 @2026-05-17T09:38:00) Wants to photograph Callum's plate set for a proper record.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Simone, group-interaction, t6 @2026-04-12T09:43:00) Simone offers to take photos for everyone; Reuben declines (will take own photo); offer stands for others.
agent_answer: D. Yuki — Yuki is the only member with no record on this matter, so per the memory, she is the one who does not follow the norm.
